The runtime was duplicated in every remote entry, so a page downloaded the same code once per app. The change that fixed it is commit `04f538d` (PR #1853, "Federate most of the Module Federation runtime"), tracked as ticket O3-5873.

**Why it was a problem:** Each remote's entry embedded its own copy of `@module-federation/runtime-core`, so the same code was downloaded once per app. The changeset gives the measured size: `@openmrs/esm-login-app`'s production remote entry dropped from ~85 kB to ~32 kB raw (~26 kB to ~9.7 kB gzipped). The remainder is per-build glue plus ~14 kB of runtime that stays per remote (`.changeset/mf-runtime-shipped-once.md:8-14`).

**What the app shell does now:** It publishes the runtime once, and remotes read it from a global.
- Remote builds set `experiments.externalRuntime: true` in the rspack config, so they read `@module-federation/runtime-core` from the `_FEDERATION_RUNTIME_CORE` global instead of bundling it (`packages/tooling/rspack-config/src/index.ts:471-485`).
- The app shell's build provides that runtime with `provideExternalRuntime` and has no `exposes`, since Module Federation rejects that combination (`packages/shell/esm-app-shell/rspack.config.js:491-494`).
- `publishFederationRuntime()` also publishes the SDK and error-code helpers and logs an error if the runtime is missing (`packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/federation-runtime.ts:26-42`). It is called from the shell entry (`packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/index.ts:1-6`).
- `@module-federation/runtime` and `webpack-bundler-runtime` stay bundled in each remote, because they cache a federation instance at module scope and sharing them fails with RUNTIME-010 (`packages/tooling/rspack-config/src/index.ts:527-530`).

**Caveats:**
- The ticket comes from the changeset header (`(feat) O3-5873: ...`). The commit message has no ticket key, and a search for O3-5873 in commit messages found nothing.
- This is a breaking change. Apps built with the new tooling need an app shell of this version or newer, and the changeset explains the compatibility rules.
- The webpack config makes the same change (`packages/tooling/webpack-config/src/index.ts:541`). Webpack-built remote entries grow slightly (~8.7 kB to ~23 kB raw) because they now carry a Module Federation runtime at all.

**Why it was a problem:** Each remote's entry embedded its own copy of `@module-federation/runtime-core`, so the same code was downloaded once per app. The changeset gives the measured size: `@openmrs/esm-login-app`'s production remote entry dropped from ~85 kB to ~32 kB raw (~26 kB to ~9.7 kB gzipped).
